name: Pulse
description_en:
Pulse is a product in the Team collaboration category. Its directory profile covers Synchronous Editing, Discussion Boards, Content Management, Project Management, Contact Management.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Individuals. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $5.00. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: organize content through creation, revision and publication; coordinate project tasks, responsibilities and progress; store and organize people, organizations and their contact details. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 个人用户。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 在线支持。
